title: The Guardian of the Ancient Sect
summary: A terrifying guardian rises in the underground palace, at least a Five Yuan Nirvana expert, and everyone flees. The Four Great Clans force the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet's exit open early with their combined Yuan Power. At the collapsing exit Lin Langtian leaves Lin Dong behind, and it turns out the guardian is chasing Lin Langtian's stolen Qiankun Bag, which has landed with Lin Dong. Lin Dong finds it is full of Nirvana Pills. Trapped, he fights the guardian with the Demon Ape Transformation, his halberd, his Symbol Puppet, Little Mink and Little Flame. Finally he uses the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, which leaves his body unable to move; the guardian, Tian Ze, recognises his sect's secret art, and the Black-Eyed Elder appears and tells him Lin Dong is his heir. Tian Ze restores Lin Dong's Yuan Power and lets him go, and Lin Dong leaves the tablet to raise his cultivation and look for the Ancestral Symbol.
events: The guardian appears; Lin Mu and the Four Great Clans lead a retreat to the tablet's exit.
The four clans pour their Yuan Power into the tablet and force the exit open before its time.
Lin Dong saves Mu Qianqian at the collapsing exit; Lin Langtian tells him to stay and die.
The guardian was chasing Lin Langtian's Qiankun Bag from the palace; Lin Dong now holds it, and it is full of Nirvana Pills.
The other factions blame Lin Langtian for their losses and leave; Lin Dong is left facing the guardian.
Lin Dong uses everything he has, ending with the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, and is left paralysed.
Tian Ze recognises the secret art; the Black-Eyed Elder says he passed the Ancestral Symbol's will to Lin Dong, and Tian Ze spares him.
Lin Dong wakes Little Mink, leaves the tablet and sets his goals: grow stronger, then find the Ancestral Symbol.
cultivation: The guardian Tian Ze is at least a Five Yuan Nirvana expert. Lin Dong's body cannot yet bear the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
